protocol.name: fixed_manifest_prefix_rollout_suite
protocol.selection: first trajectories in saved split-manifest order
protocol.acceleration_evaluation: physical acceleration error on every saved true state from state 0 through rollout_steps
protocol.failure_definition: non-finite position, velocity, or acceleration prediction; or max-step position RMSE greater than failure_threshold

conservation.center_of_mass_drift_definition: Euclidean distance from the trajectory's initial center of mass
conservation.comparison: predicted_minus_true subtracts the saved numerical trajectory drift from predicted drift per trajectory
